parameters.query:
-- $1 rows (JSON array), $2 number of invalid events
-- Duplicate event ids (retried deliveries) are ignored.
WITH incoming AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS e(
    event_id text, ts timestamptz, source text, type text,
    project_root text, project_name text, data jsonb)
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO activity_events (event_id, ts, source, type, project_root, project_name, data)
  SELECT event_id, ts, source, type, project_root, project_name, COALESCE(data, '{}'::jsonb)
  FROM incoming
  ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING event_id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM incoming)::int AS received,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM inserted)::int AS accepted,
       $2::int AS invalid
